errors.text: The proposed SLM and rapid solution-annealing route replaces the target ink extrusion, hydrogen de-binding, high-vacuum sintering, and water-quenching process.
The suggested composition includes Mo and W, which are Group VI elements and do not reconstruct the targeted Group IV-V HfNbTaTiZr family.

The hypothesis claims mitigation of interstitial brittleness without specifying a credible oxygen-removal or oxygen-control mechanism; its mechanism instead focuses mainly on suppressing Laves phases.
Oxidation resistance is predicted without an oxidation-control intervention analogous to the target silicide coating and self-healing oxide mechanism.
The cited evidence does not establish that oscillating SLM scanning plus rapid annealing suppresses Laves phases or retains a beneficial dislocation structure in this refractory alloy family.
